commitThreshold: a bounded turned closure attempt with path-length and turn thresholds
memoryRule: a turned sweep is not copied; it regenerates one compound contour with a new winding and gap, and four changes remain liftable
interactionRule: pointer or touch samples a bounded turned sweep; Enter, Space, and the attempt control use deterministic sweeps; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: split-margin folds, cut-cell vacancy, and open filament organism -> one compound SVG contour with an interior absence
compositionRupture: distributed fields and open spine -> one asymmetrical body centred around a moving void
encounterRupture: two-edge offer, proximity tour, and drawn stroke -> a turned closure attempt sampled as a temporary path
temporalRupture: remote fold roles, vacancy ledger, and filament growth -> accumulated winding and gap memory inside one path
mediumRupture: many independent SVG paths -> one even-odd compound SVG path whose d is regenerated
changedRule: A straight offer is flat and refused. A bounded turned sweep changes the winding and gap of one compound contour; the sweep itself disappears.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one singular SVG contour with a deep interior. A valid release changes its gap, interior, lean, and path signature while preserving one contour; four turns persist.
falsifier: Delete if a straight sweep commits, if the pointer trace survives, if only colour/readout changes, if the blind object reads as a generic logo or ring, if later turns reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v039 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the singular-contour grammar from v036-v038 or if the turned closure attempt is not materially produced.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
